generator_cmd: truncate -s 4M l1.img; printf pw | LD_LIBRARY_PATH=<cs>/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu <cs>/usr/sbin/cryptsetup --disable-locks --batch-mode (cryptsetup-bin 2:2.8.4-1ubuntu4 via apt-get download + dpkg-deb -x) luksFormat --type luks1 --cipher aes-cbc-essiv:sha256 --key-size 256 --hash sha1 --uuid 3f2a9c1e-7b44-4d0a-9e1f-5a6b7c8d9e01 --pbkdf-force-iterations 1000 --key-file - l1.img; cryptsetup luksAddKey --key-file <(printf pw) --pbkdf-force-iterations 1000 l1.img k2; head -c 4096 l1.img > luks1_essiv.bin
oracle_cmd: cryptsetup luksDump l1.img -> 'Cipher name: aes'; cryptsetup luksDump l1.img (full image); file -b luks1_essiv.bin -> 'LUKS encrypted file, ver 1 [aes, cbc-essiv:sha256, sha1] UUID: 3f2a9c1e-..., at 0x1000 data, 32 key bytes, ...; slot #0 active, ...; slot #1 active'
